name: EPIC 220158822
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 5.7 solar radii and 1.19 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220158822 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM radius (solar radii) 5.701544 (16th-84th percentiles 5.485699-5.925361), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220158822 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM mass (solar masses) 1.187179 (16th-84th percentiles 1.087043-1.295793), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220158822: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 5277.616 +/- 56 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220158822 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 2490.761719 (16th-84th percentiles 2418.320312-2564.804688), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.18 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 2,491 parsecs away, 6 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 1.19 solar masses and 5.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,278 K at its surface.
